name: liveboom
description: Liveboom — red social de lives, videos cortos y monetización

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev -w @liveboom/web"
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting --project liveboom-app
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting,functions --project liveboom-app
